narr: A plume of tropical moisture led to multiple rounds of showers and thunderstorms which resulted in flooding and flash flooding.
ev: Water was flowing across Masonboro Sound Rd. at Finian Dr.
Partial washouts occurred along Malmo Loop Rd. approximately 2 to 3 miles from Highway 74 and the road was impassable.
Multiple vehicles were stalled and rescues occurred in several areas across portions of Wilmington, NC, especially along 13th St. and Rankin St. where the water was chest deep.
